title: D-087 CAD-3: strict-subset DXF reader - ASCII DXF LINE / LWPOLYLINE / POLYLINE-VERTEX / 3DFACE / TEXT on named layers into typed primitives with declared units; bounded, fail-closed refusal values, never an exception (module + tests; not wired)
objective: Build services/api/app/drawings/dxf_reader.py: a dependency-free STRICT-SUBSET reader for ASCII DXF (the open AutoCAD interchange format; binary DXF refused) that turns the group-code stream into typed, layer-tagged primitives - LINE, LWPOLYLINE (closed flag; bulge arcs refused or flattened under a declared tolerance), POLYLINE/VERTEX/SEQEND, 3DFACE, TEXT - plus the header's declared drawing units and version; anything outside the subset (blocks/INSERT, splines, hatches, proxy objects, xdata) is counted and disclosed or refused per a written rule; malformed pairs, bad numbers, over-limit sizes/entity counts are typed refusal VALUES, all-or-nothing per file. Units are REPORTED, never assumed (no units header = 'unitless', confirmed by the user later - phase-C honesty). Not wired to any route (a later gated packet puts it behind the parser-isolation gate).
business_reason: The owner asked for CAD editing, not only export (D-087-R006): reading a DXF back is the licence-free path to bring AutoCAD drawings into the product; native DWG stays an owner licensing decision (R007).
inputs: PRODUCER MODE (binding): you are an orchestrator-dispatched subagent producer working ONLY inside your task worktree (named in the dispatch). Every file path you write is under that worktree; commit your work there as ONE commit and report its sha. Never touch the primary checkout, the ledger, or any path outside allowed_paths.

KNOWN BROKER LIMIT: documented commands may be runnable only from the worktree root - route blocked runs to harvest with an exact recipe, never predict-as-observed.

ZERO NEW DEPENDENCIES (binding; D-087-R009 + the dependency-security policy): stdlib plus already-admitted packages only (shapely/numpy/pydantic/fastapi are admitted); no lockfile or requirements change; no network access in code or tests.

NO EXPOSURE (binding): no route, endpoint, app/main.py, or web change - this packet ships a tested module only; wiring is a later gated packet. The max-envelope route stays UNMOUNTED (its mount preconditions are unchanged).

FORMAT AUTHORITY (binding; never guess): group codes per the Autodesk DXF Reference - cite per constant, '[recalled - verify]' for the G1 verifier; sibling research M5-T084 records the official notes. Untrusted input: bounded file size, line length, entity count, vertex count, nesting; no eval, no network; refusal is a VALUE.

TESTS + MUTATION (binding): hand-written DXF fixtures inside the test file (a closed LWPOLYLINE lot, a POLYLINE building, 3DFACE walls, TEXT, an unknown entity, a unitless file, malformed pairs, a binary-DXF sentinel, an over-limit file); mutation: dropping the entity-count bound or the pair-parity check reddens a named test. Do NOT import the concurrent M5-T081 writer - round-trip tests with it belong to a later packet.

Run `python tools/code_graph/query.py --no-regen impact <path>` before sweeps; graph ADVISORY - verify every material conclusion in actual source.

DISCOVERY ROUTING (D-069, binding): out-of-scope product/domain/defect findings go in the report's DISCOVERIES section - never fixed in-packet; the orchestrator records them in docs/DISCOVERY_BACKLOG.md at the seam.
outputs: services/api/app/drawings/dxf_reader.py - strict-subset DXF reader with typed primitives + refusal values
services/api/tests/drawings/test_dxf_reader.py - subset, units, disclosure, refusal and bound tests with mutation notes
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (subset): a fixture with a closed LWPOLYLINE lot, a POLYLINE building, 3DFACE walls and TEXT yields typed primitives with exact coordinates, layer names and closed flags.
AS-2 (units honesty): the header's drawing units are reported with the reference code; a file without a units header is reported 'unitless' - never assumed feet.
AS-3 (outside the subset): unknown entities are counted and disclosed per the written rule; binary DXF and blocks/INSERT follow the documented refuse-or-disclose rule.

AS-4 (fail-closed + bounds): odd pair counts, non-numeric coordinates, over-limit sizes/entities/vertices each return a typed refusal VALUE (no exception escapes), all-or-nothing; mutation - removing the entity-count bound or the pair-parity check reddens.
AS-5 (scope): not wired anywhere; zero new dependencies; ruff + modularity clean; exactly the allowed_paths change.
